native_detector.interpretation: Native and common preprocessing jointly differ in resolution, geometry and JPEG processing; native128 images invoke officialCenterCrop padding. Contrast is descriptive, not a causal attribution of detector failure.

novelty_assessment.qualitative: Credible scoped decision-layer/evaluation contribution; strong marked recall gains, but limited component necessity and transfer evidence. High novelty is not established.
limitations: Most marked recall is recovered by the simpler complete-message union; primary advantage is the smaller secondary paired difference.
No-null and no-stability ablations slightly outperform the complete objective without observable unmarked/source-FPR cost.
Full unconstrained logistic achieves higher marked recall but was prospectively ineligible on development; its outcome remains material.
Preserved unmarked TPR is only about2.46%; noninferiority does not solve unmarked generalization.
CLIP correction loses clearly to the simple union and the tuned-confidence secondary rule.
Native UFD scores a different unmarked native/common identity task with pooled calibration, so direct superiority comparisons are invalid.
